build_proposal_generator_from_cfg: build a proposal generator from a detectron2 config and input shape using build_proposal_generator
register_custom_proposal_generator: register a custom proposal generator class with PROPOSAL_GENERATOR_REGISTRY for use in detectron2
use_precomputed_proposals: set MODEL.PROPOSAL_GENERATOR.NAME to PrecomputedProposals to skip building a proposal generator
review_PROPOSAL_GENERATOR_REGISTRY: review the PROPOSAL_GENERATOR_REGISTRY to see registered RPN and RRPN proposal generators
summarize_build_proposal_generator: summarize the build_proposal_generator function which constructs RPN or RRPN modules from config
